static_traits.name: 李致远
static_traits.family_status: 家中五个孩子中的长子
static_traits.social_status: Strained relationships with family members；有兄弟姐妹与其他家人可交流，但not愿与他们讨论自己的失望感
static_traits.medical_history: 有过在压力性家庭情境中出现的类似失望感；not yet接受过心理咨询；without显著生理疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能自我Reflection、配合度较好；语气谨慎，存在大量“应该”句式与自我苛责

basic_info.main_problem: 作为长子，他长期觉得自己应该更负责，因此一直感到让家人失望；在面对需要承担责任的任务或决策时，这种失望和not足感每天都会出现。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些失望与not足感已影响到心理健康与整体情绪，使他难以应对日常责任，因此希望通过咨询来减轻失望与not足感并改善心境与功能。
growth_experiences: 青少年时期家庭发生危机，父母overwhelmed，他作为长子需要承担更多家庭责任，如督促弟妹完成作业、偶尔做饭、在生活中随时照顾弟妹。初时因能够帮忙而感到自豪，随后逐渐觉得自己永远做得not够，一旦出现问题便归咎于自己，形成“作为长子必须更负责”的内在规则与持续的自我责备。

special_situations.event: 在Family gatherings时与兄弟姐妹比较自己的人生与成就
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 作为长子，我必须比弟妹做得更多、更好，才能算合格、not让家人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断与他人比较、给自己设定更高更严格的标准
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，我应该做得更好

special_situations.event: Agreed to help the brother handle important financial documents but made errors, corrected by the brother
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在重要任务上出现任何错误，就说明我not负责任、让人失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Volunteers for more tasks to make up for mistakes, redoubling corrections to prove responsibility
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该更懂事，I always mess things up

special_situations.event: Every day, when facing tasks requiring responsibility or making decisions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As the eldest son, I must do everything well, otherwise my family will be disappointed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度Self-monitoring、避免与家人讨论感受以免“增加负担”

special_situations.event: When recalling crises that happened in the family and the responsibilities he bore back then
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有持续承担并完成更多责任，才能证明我有价值；一旦做得not够就说明我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continually pressures oneself to do more and do better in family matters
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我not更负责，就会让家人失望

core_conflict.wish: As the eldest son, longs to be seen as reliable and responsible and to earn family recognition and respect
core_conflict.fear: 害怕让家人失望、被评判为not称职，从而not被接纳
defense_goal: Avoids being blamed through excessive responsibility-taking and self-reproach; reduces expression of personal feelings so as not to burden the family

object_relations.self_representation: not够称职、容易让人失望的长子
object_relations.object_representation: Family who hold high expectations of oneself and may be disappointed (caring, but viewed by him as potential judges)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on 'how the family truly views him' or asks him to find evidence to test the assumption
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为他人心里在责备或失望（将内在自我批评Projection到他人看法）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气谨慎，use“他们大概会……”等假设性表达，强调担心被失望的可能性，避免绝对化指控。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被鼓励与家人讨论个人失望与not足感以寻求支持时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes that once she expresses herself she will add burden and trouble to the family
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以关心他人为理由婉拒，强调“我not该麻烦do not人”，语气礼貌、回避深入情感细节。

manifestations: Bound by the value condition 'as the eldest son one should be more responsible', finding it hard to act according to one's own limits and real choices
在重要任务上将错误等同为“not称职”，被僵化规则支配
outcomes: 持续的自我苛责与失望感
Decreased motivation与任务生产力降低

manifestations: not愿与家人谈及失望与not足感，担心成为负担
在Family gatherings中内心比较并Self-denial，难以建立真实联结
outcomes: Low mood、应对责任的能力受影响

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 反复use“作为长子我应该……”的句式
以僵化的责任标准评价自我成败

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: not向家人表达真实感受，担心给他们增加负担
Turns energy that could be directed outward for help into self-criticism and self-demands

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 尽管家人not yet表达失望，仍假设他们在心里看轻自己
在任务失误后自动认为他人会not满或贬低自己

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: In responsibility scenarios, excessively examines oneself, repeatedly reflecting 'I should have been more sensible'
Cautious and afraid of disappointing others, reducing emotional contact with family

positive_force: 有兄弟姐妹与家人作为潜在支持系统
主动寻求咨询，态度开放且愿意记录与Reflection
具备责任感并愿意承担家庭任务
negative_force: 僵化的“应该”规则与完美化责任标准
自我苛责与将错误过度等同为“not称职”
Mind-reading assumptions of others' disappointment; comparison with others triggers inferiority
not愿表达感受导致Relationship tension与支持难以获得

target_behavior.behavior: 在承担家庭责任或比较情境中出现强烈的Self-denial与失望，并回避与家人讨论感受
antecedent: 帮助家人处理重要事务（如财务文件）
Family gatherings时与兄弟姐妹进行比较
面对需要承担责任的任务或决策
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjection的“作为长子必须更负责”的僵化规则，将错误视为“not称职”并以自我苛责维持价值感
target_behavior.function: Avoids the risk of being judged or disappointing others, trying to maintain the self and family harmony through self-control and doubled effort
target_behavior.consequence: Tense family relationships、Low mood与失望感加剧；Decreased motivation、任务生产力降低，日常功能受损
